messages:
kevin: Quick FYI team — all-hands next Wednesday 9:30am PT. Title: 'Launch wrap & policy pulse'. Plan: ~40m: 8m exec summary, 12m launch metrics + incident learnings, 8m policy update (rollout/freeze + telemetry), 7m customer spotlights, 5m live Q&A. Drop any must-cover bullets here by EOD Monday. @here

stella: Invite is up: <https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3374012345>. Please RSVP and indicate if you'll attend remotely or in-person (we're capping in-room seats).

maria: For the incident segment: I'll present a 90s RCA of Saturday's cache invalidation cascade and the new "48h soft rollout freeze" we want to test. Will post a 1-paragraph summary & mitigation checklist here by Tue noon.

luc: For policy update: legal-bot and I will walk through the new telemetry retention defaults and the opt-out flow for Dedicated/Private customers. Also want to announce a small change to our deployment rollback window.

ops_bot: Ops note: during the incident we failed over to standby routing which increased cost ~2% for the hour; we'll include the cost impact slides in the metrics block. Postmortem will be linked after the meeting.

kevin: Accessibility: captions ON, transcript attached after. If you need ASL or language interpretation reply here: "interpretation: yes". We'll try to book interpreters if requested by Tue EOD.

stella: Presenters: upload slides to the shared deck by Tue 5pm. Link: <https://drive.redwood.com/allhands/launch-wrap-3374>. Keep demos under 90s. If you need presenter rights DM me.

maria: LIVE  question: will the soft rollout freeze block emergency security patches?

legal-bot: LIVE answer: security patches are exempt — the freeze is scoped to non-critical feature rollouts. We'll clarify the exemption in the slide and add a quick escalation flow.

luc: Quick ask: if your team has a short customer highlight (1 line + opt-in contact), drop it here. We'll pick two for spotlights.

kevin: For Q intake: use the thread OR the form <https://forms.redwood.com/allhands-qa-3374>. Mark LIVE at the start if you want to ask on-air. We'll triage ahead of time.

stella: allhands-bot will auto-record and post transcript + recording to #all-hands-resources after the meeting. Reminders scheduled: 48h, 3h, and 15m before start. :bell:

maria: Action items so far: 1) Presenters upload slides Tue 5pm (owners: product, infra, legal). 2) Maria to post incident summary Tue noon. 3) Luc/legal to finalize policy slides Mon EOD. 4) Everyone: drop Qs here or use the form. I'll publish a final agenda and speaker order Tue evening. Thanks! :rocket:
